structure.unit: Crimes Against the Administration of Justice
Escape Of, Communications With and Deliveries to Prisoners

law.catch_line: Prisoner escaping from jail; how punished
law.text: If any person confined in jail or in custody after conviction of a criminal offense shall escape by force or violence, other than by setting fire thereto, he shall be guilty of a Class 6 felony. The term of confinement under this section shall commence from the expiration of the former sentence.
